data.name: A Little Help
data.detailed_description:
Anything is Possible with A Little Help!

You and a Co-Op Partner must slip into the roles of The Scientist, a serious type locked deep underground in a bunker, and their latest creation, The Doll, a miniature robot with a heart of gold!

Explore the small window into the post-apocalyptic world set before them through the eyes of an inventor and their latest creation, as he puts them through a series of unique tests that require teamwork and communication to complete.

Game Features

  • Engage in fun Co-op puzzles alongside your partner and communicate in order to complete each test!

  • Swing and run through unique mini-worlds as the Doll, platforming your way to the exit.

  • Keep your eyes and ears peeled as the Scientist, making certain that your secret personal project isn't discovered by your employers, whilst juggling repairing and aiding the Doll.

  • Uncover the secrets of the strange post-apocalyptic future...or past, that A Little Help is set in, through letters and documents from the world above.
